audit_comparison.classification_impact: none: the primary CI lower bound stays > 0 under either quantile, and the terminal CI still contains 0
audit_comparison.difference_scope: Every difference is confined to the Student-t quantile and to the confidence-interval endpoints computed from it. The point estimates, sample SDs, all 30 per-seed d_s values, the censoring counts, the accounting totals, the durations, the grad-ratio summaries and the terminal teacher diagnostics are bit-identical, and both classifications are unchanged.
audit_comparison.magnitude: a few ulps, i.e. absolute differences on the order of 1e-15 or smaller
audit_comparison.purpose: Independent recomputation versus the numbers recorded in audit_result.json. The audit file is read here only to report agreement and difference; no value in this document is taken from it.
audit_comparison.root_cause: The two sides invert the Student-t CDF with different numerical routines, so their doubles for t_{0.975,29} differ by a few units in the last place; that difference propagates to the CI endpoints at the same scale. It is not a disagreement about the data.

checkpoint_kind_classification.caveat: Apart from the absent checkpoint_kind key, the u10000 pack's top-level and extra key sets are identical to the periodic packs, so the derived 'full_snapshot' label must not be read as evidence that the u10000 file carries extra optimizer, scheduler or RNG state. checkpoint_kind_classification.classification_rule: Within U, extra.checkpoint_kind == 'periodic_model_only' is taken from the packed field when present, and the checkpoint is classified 'full_snapshot' when the field is absent. The string 'full_snapshot' is NOT stored in any checkpoint pack. The rule is scoped to U on purpose: run-wide the field is also absent at updates 0, 10, 25, 50, 100 and 200, so applying the rule outside U would label those early diagnostic packs full_snapshot as well.

The absent marker therefore tracks 'written as a snapshot rather than as a periodic model-only write', which is what the derived u10000 label means and all it means. censoring.caveat: Censoring does not change the locked primary formula, but the two arms have different censoring structure, so this support must not be described as an uncensored survival advantage.

primary.classification_rule: support iff CI lower bound > 0; contrary iff CI upper < 0; else indeterminate
primary.estimator: d_s = (1/35) * sum_{u in U} (elapsed_aux(u,s) - elapsed_control(u,s)) over U = {3200, 3400, ..., 10000}; point estimate is mean_s d_s over the 30 eval seeds; inference is a two-sided paired Student-t 95% CI with n=30, df=29.
primary.independence_caveat: The 35 checkpoints are time-correlated points on one trajectory sharing 30 eval seeds; they are not 35 independent replications. n is 30 seeds, not 35 checkpoints.
primary.t_quantile_method: The Student-t CDF built from the regularized incomplete beta was inverted with mpmath.findroot at 60 decimal working digits, and that high-precision root was then rounded to the nearest IEEE-754 double, which is the value stored in t_quantile_0975_df29. The stored double therefore carries about 16 significant decimal digits, not 60: the 40-digit string in t_quantile_exact_40_significant_digits is the high-precision root, not the precision of the stored double or of the CI endpoints. The CI endpoints themselves are computed in ordinary double precision, so their last one or two decimal digits are sensitive to the inversion routine at the few-ulp level; see audit_comparison.
primary.t_quantile_rounding: nearest IEEE-754 double of the 60-digit root

aux.content_description: One JSON object per PPO update, 10000 rows. The 27 keys present in every row are exactly: update; n_samples and n_retention_samples (per-update sample/frame counts); optimizer_steps; total_loss, ppo_policy_loss, ppo_value_loss, approx_kl, clip_fraction, entropy, explained_variance (PPO diagnostics); retention_hybrid_loss, retention_hard_ce, retention_soft_ce, retention_soft_kl (retention losses); alpha, grad_ratio, g_ppo_norm, g_ret_norm, g_ret_weighted_norm, cosine_similarity and the nested grad_alignment object (frozen-alpha retention mechanism); scripted_survival_mean (rollout survival) and the nested rollout_censoring object holding censor_count, censor_rate and n_rollouts; collect_wall_s, ppo_wall_s, total_wall_s. There is no rollout seed window key and no timestamp key in these rows. The 10000 rows are deliberately not embedded; they are bound by exact path, SHA-256 and byte size above so the file can be re-derived and re-verified.
aux.rollout_seed_window_note: 'rollout_seed_window' is not one of this file's per-row keys. Per-update seed windows were never persisted here; see rollout_seed_window_provenance.

control.content_description: One JSON object per PPO update, 10000 rows. The 15 keys present in every row are exactly: update; n_samples (per-update sample/frame count); optimizer_steps; total_loss, policy_loss, value_loss, approx_kl, clip_fraction, entropy, explained_variance (PPO diagnostics); scripted_survival_mean (rollout survival) and the nested rollout_censoring object holding censor_count, censor_rate and n_rollouts; collect_wall_s, ppo_wall_s, total_wall_s. The control arm has no retention terms, so it carries no alpha, grad_ratio or gradient-norm keys, and its PPO loss keys are policy_loss / value_loss rather than the aux arm's ppo_policy_loss / ppo_value_loss. There is no rollout seed window key and no timestamp key in these rows. The 10000 rows are deliberately not embedded; they are bound by exact path, SHA-256 and byte size above so the file can be re-derived and re-verified.
control.rollout_seed_window_note: 'rollout_seed_window' is not one of this file's per-row keys. Per-update seed windows were never persisted here; see rollout_seed_window_provenance.

aux_additional_direct_evidence.explanation: The aux arm calibrated alpha once on the update-1 on-policy rollouts. report.json alpha_calibration.rollout_seed_window, the identical extra.alpha_calibration block inside every aux pack, and the aux recovery.pt calib_seeds and first_update_rollouts[].seed all record 130000-130007 as the window that update 1 actually consumed. That makes update 1 a directly observed corresponding update for aux. The control arm has no calibration step, no alpha_calibration block anywhere, and a recovery.pt with no calib_seeds, first_update_rollouts or last_update_rollouts keys, so update 1 is not directly observed for control.

counts_by_arm.reading_guide: checkpoint_pack_window_records counts files, not updates: each arm has 55 update-indexed packs and every one of them carries an extra.rollout_seed_window. updates_with_corresponding_direct_persisted_observation counts distinct training updates u in 1..10000 for which some artifact directly persists the window the locked schedule assigns to that same u. The two numbers differ because the u0 pack's window belongs to update 1 rather than to update 0, and because the aux calibration record evidences update 1 without being a checkpoint pack.

tier_1_checkpoint_file_records.description: On-disk records. Each arm holds 55 update-indexed checkpoint packs at updates {0, 10, 25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 600, ..., 10000} and every one of them carries extra.rollout_seed_window as a contiguous enumeration of exactly 8 seeds. Each arm additionally holds one ppo_*_final.pt carrying the update-10000 window. This tier counts files.

tier_2_unique_corresponding_update_evide.description: Distinct training updates whose own scheduled window is directly persisted somewhere in the bundle. This tier counts updates, not files, and is strictly smaller than the file count for control and equal to it for aux for two different reasons: the u0 pack is not a corresponding record, and the aux calibration record adds update 1.
tier_2_unique_corresponding_update_evide.why_aux_exceeds_control_by_one: aux has the consumed update-1 calibration window; control has no calibration step and therefore no update-1 observation.

tier_3_deterministic_reconstruction_only.description: Updates whose window exists only as a value computed from the locked schedule. These windows are reconstructible exactly, but they are calculated, not observed, and must never be described as verified on-disk records.

rollout_seed_window_provenance.finding: Neither per-update progress JSONL carries a rollout seed window: the aux rows have 27 keys and the control rows have 15, and 'rollout_seed_window' is in neither key set. The window is persisted only inside checkpoint packs and, for aux only, in the alpha calibration record. This revision opened every checkpoint pack in both RO arm directories rather than only the 35 U packs, which raised the directly evidenced update count from 35 per arm to 55 for aux and 54 for control.

inspection_scope.description: Every update-indexed checkpoint pack, the final pack and the live recovery.pt were opened in both arms after hash verification against RO. The 201 recovery_archives/update_<N>.pt files per arm were not opened; see checkpoint_pack_seed_window_inventory.not_inspected.
inspection_scope.previous_revision_scope: the 35 U packs per arm only

rollout_seed_window_provenance.observed_update_to_window_source_list_de: One row per observed on-disk (update, window) record: the arm, the update the record corresponds to under the locked schedule, a descriptive evidence class, the source file and its SHA-256, the source field, and the window endpoints. corresponds_to_update is null for the u0 packs, whose window belongs to update 1 rather than to their own update. The tier-2 counts are the number of DISTINCT non-null corresponds_to_update values per arm, not the number of rows: several rows can restate the same update (ppo_*_final.pt and the aux recovery fields do exactly that) and restating it does not raise the count.
rollout_seed_window_provenance.reconstruction_note: Because rollout_seed_start is locked at 130000 and the schedule advances by exactly 8 seeds per update, the window for any update is a closed-form function of the update index. Every update's window is therefore reconstructible, but for updates with no persisted record the value is computed rather than observed.

u0_pack_record.conclusion: The u0 pack is a persisted window record but not a corresponding one. It is the pre-training snapshot written before update 1 ran, and its window field holds the window update 1 was about to consume. It must not be read as an observation of an update-0 window, because no rollouts are drawn at update 0, and it is not counted as direct evidence for update 1 either, because the field is labelled update 0 and says nothing about what update 1 actually consumed. For aux that same window is independently evidenced as consumed by update 1 through the calibration record; for control it is not.

self_consistency.recompute_basis: Every reported field was derived from the RO bundle in this pass. Checkpoint tensors and source blocks were read from the local audit copies only after each copy's SHA-256 was confirmed equal to the RO file's SHA-256; JSON, JSONL and directory listings were read from the RO mirror directly. No value was taken from the journal prose. audit_result.json was read for exactly two purposes, both labelled: quoting its provenance_gap string and populating the audit_comparison block; no reported measurement is sourced from it. In this revision every checkpoint pack in both RO arm directories was opened, not only the 35 U packs; each local copy was hash-verified against RO first.

local_audit_result.what_it_actually_records: audit_result.json holds operational_integrity == 'pass', a provenance_gap string, and recomputed primary / terminal / teacher / accounting / grad-ratio numbers. It has no verdict, decision, status or review field, and the strings 'ACCEPTED' and 'REJECTED' do not appear in it. Any run-level accept/reject conclusion belongs to the review process, not to this artifact, and must not be attributed to it.

sources.locked_init_checkpoint_path_authority: preregistration only; the run bundle does not record any init-checkpoint path, so the locked path is the contract's intent and not an observed launch fact

ro_aux_directory_listing_alias.explanation: The read-only mirror is a CIFS mount negotiated at SMB dialect 3.1.1. 'aux' is a reserved DOS device name, so the server returns a mangled 8.3 alias for that directory entry in listings; the alias and the canonical '.../aux' path are the same directory. Citing the RO arm roots as '.../{aux,control}' is therefore correct, but a raw directory listing will show the alias instead of 'aux'. Arm identity here rests on bundle content (run.json arm and tool fields, ppo_aux_* file names), not on the directory name.
ro_aux_directory_listing_alias.identity_evidence: identical child listings and identical run.json / report.json SHA-256 through both path spellings

ro_mount.note: The mount is CIFS negotiated at SMB dialect 3.1.1 (mount option vers=3.1.1). An earlier revision described it as SMB2; that was wrong and is withdrawn. The dialect does not change any measured value; it only describes the transport the RO mirror was read over.

rw_training_paths_as_recorded_in_report.note: These absolute 88_minion_rw paths are strings embedded in report.json. They were not resolved or verified from this host; only the RO mirror was read.

limitations: support is a seed-averaged late-curve elapsed advantage, not 35 independent replications
terminal u10000 survival does not support the same direction and its CI contains 0
aux has one censored primary cell (u9200, seed 3025) against zero for control, so this is not an uncensored survival advantage
frames and optimizer steps are not matched; equal-frame or equal-optimizer-step reinterpretation is forbidden
teacher agreement and KL are secondary and must not carry a retention claim alone
the result is bound to PPO seed 11 and rollout window 130000-209999 and does not generalize to other seeds or windows
no checkpoint is promoted; experimental checkpoints must not initialize production

launch argv, host, GPU model/count/driver, CUDA runtime/driver and the init-checkpoint launch path are unrecorded, so launch-path compliance is unverified even though content identity is verified; the interpreter, numpy, torch and device-ordinal values that are available come from checkpoint-creation records, not from a launch snapshot

per-update rollout seed windows were not persisted in either progress JSONL; within the inspected artifacts 55 distinct corresponding training updates for aux and 54 for control have a direct persisted observation, while the remaining 9945 aux and 9946 control updates are reconstruction-only from the locked schedule; the 201 recovery archives per arm were not opened, so any seed-window records they may hold are outside this inspected scope
u10000 is classified full_snapshot by derivation from the absent extra.checkpoint_kind field, not from any packed field asserting that kind
the CI endpoints differ from audit_result.json by a few ulps because the two sides invert the Student-t CDF differently; the point estimates and both classifications are unaffected
